Alex: Hey team — we need quota + a capacity reservation in swedencentral (Sweden Central) for ND/NC SKUs to run canary perf tests next month. Anyone able to open the Azure support request?
Maya: I can. Can you paste the exact SKUs, counts, subscription id and requested dates?
Alex: Sure — see details below. Pls include request for subnet size and NSG port limits as well.
Alex: ```
Subscription: 8f3b2c1d-0a9e-4b66-9f2a-1234567890ab
Region: swedencentral
SKUs & quota needed:
- Standard_ND40rs_v2 : 8 (reserve 6, burst 2)
- Standard_NC24rs_v3 : 4 (reserve 2, burst 2)
Networking:
- Request /27 subnet (for node pools + infra)
- Increase concurrent connection limit on NSG to 100000 (to avoid port exhaustion during perf runs)
Requested start: 2026-04-05
Reason: Dedicated canary runs for inference runtime + QA load tests
Cost center: infra-experiments
Contact: alex@redwood.com
```
Liam: Quick Q — do you want an Azure Capacity Reservation or just quota + ability to create VMs? Reservations give stronger capacity guarantees but require commit.
Alex: We prefer a hybrid: reserve 6 ND40rs and 2 NC24rs for steady throughput, allow bursting to quota for the rest. We'll do short-term financial approval.
Maya: Opening ticket now. I'll include that we want both quota increase and capacity reservation guidance from MS.
capacity-bot: Microsoft Support ticket created: SR# 9876543210 — https://portal.azure.com/#blade/Microsoft_Azure_Support/SupportRequest/overview/id/9876543210 (assigned to CSE: Anders L.)
Olivia: Estimated monthly delta for 6 reserved ND40rs + 2 reserved NC24rs? Need a ballpark for finance sign-off.
Alex: Rough calc: ND40rs reserved 6 ~= $18k/mo, NC24rs reserved 2 ~= $2.5k/mo, plus burst/on-demand ~ $7k/mo depending on hours. Total ~ $27.5k/mo. Will refine after formal quote.
Liam: Suggest we try reserved for critical nodes and keep 2-4 spot/on-demand for spike tests. Lower immediate commit. :+1:
Alex: Agreed. Plan: reserve 6 ND, reserve 2 NC, burst quota for remaining. Finance approval pending.
Maya: Ticket comment added with subscription + SKU block, flagged networking ask, and requested timeline. Linking our internal tracking: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFRA-4187
Maya: Action items: 1) I follow up with MS CSE and push capacity reservation options; 2) @Liam validate /27 subnet + NSG rules; 3) @Alex get finance approval by EOD Friday.
Liam: I'll validate subneting and check VNet peering implications today.
Alex: Thanks. If MS asks for quotas per VM family vs cores, we should provide both.
capacity-bot: Update from MS SR# 9876543210 — initial review done, CSE requested network diagram + workload profile. Please upload to the SR.
Olivia: I'll prep a short workload profile doc (token throughput, p95 latency targets) and drop in the SR.
Alex: Perfect — dropping the load profile there in an hour. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
Maya: Leaving a reminder to follow up Tues AM if no response.
Alex: Closing thread for now — follow-ups in INFRA-4187 and SR#9876543210.
